changelog:
@Announcements Ping Retro Rewind v6.13.3 has been released! This update/hotfix IS required to continue to play online!

# 🏎️ Retro Track Updates 🏎️
```- GBA Sky Garden has been updated to its latest release.
- Tour Ninja Hideaway has been updated to its latest release.
- Tour Bowser Castle 4 has been updated to its latest release.```

# 🙉 Character Updates 🙉
```- Removed voicelines for Kritter due to the character author's request.
- Fixed a few specific characters that caused crashes on different kart combinations.```

# 🏁 Gameplay Updates 🏁
```- Replaced a few of the retro track BRSTMs, provided by Mayro.
- Added friend room options to allow hosts to disable Hybrid Drift, Brake Drifting, and UMTs.
- Added an option to enable auto acceleration for non time trial related modes.
- Adjusted the custom engine class speed factors.```    

# ⚙️ Other Updates ⚙️
```- Added sub pages to specific settings pages. This also combines Race 1/2 settings and Froom 1/2 settings into one section each.
- Added functionality for local multiplayer to select the same characters, as well as using different custom characters, even if they are on the same slot. Implementation inspired by therenow9 on github.
- Added functionality to play custom character voice's while selecting a character. Implementation inspired by therenow9 on github.
- 350cc has now been reverted back to 500cc.```

# 🐜 Bug Fixes 🐜
```- Fixed an issue where specific controllers would not be able to toggle custom characters.
- Fixed an issue where ghosts created on former versions would desync on 200cc.
- Fixed an issue where Battle Royale and Lap KO finishing times were not being set when playing those modes offline.
- Fixed an issue where the elimination display would not display the custom character skins when playing Lap KO or Battle Royale offline.
- Fixed an issue with Knockout Mode where the KO count would not change if the former KO count would eliminate all the remaining players.
- Fixed an issue where the VS intro would not display the custom engine class the user has selected.
- Fixed an issue where there would be a black flash when entering the page to restrict vehicles for friend rooms.
- Fixed an issue where the character selected animation would sometimes play when in the character restriction page.
- Fixed an issue where the character restriction page would display the custom character skins.```

As always, please report any and all bugs to the <#1265514050335412310> channel!
Full Download: https://update.rwfc.net/RetroRewind/zip/RetroRewind.zip
